notes.subject: יעודד
notes.rationale: Strong bilong em i tok 'repeat/testify', tasol ol tanim tok i ridim 'uphold' — mi usim 'sanapim'

notes.subject: יעות
notes.rationale: 'em i bagarapim rod' o 'em i mekim rod i go kwik' — JPS 'maketh crooked', KJV 'turneth upside down'

notes.subject: יעודד
notes.rationale: ol man nogut i no gat ⟨את⟩ long Hibru — olgeta i direct object wantaim rod tasol

translation: Yahwe i lukautim ⟨את⟩ ol man i kam long narapela ples, papai bilong papa i dai na man i dai husat em i larim meri bilong en — Yahwe i sanapim ol; tasol rod bilong ol man nogut em i bagarapim.
